source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

chapter_binding.tsw_alignment_reason: The pinned SBLGNT main text contains public verse 24 and omits the movable doxology numbered 25–27; TSW omits 24 and prints the doxology at 25–27. No non-equivalent comparator text is silently aligned.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Phoebe's kinship and named church ministry.
key_decisions.before: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a deacon of the church in Cenchreae.
key_decisions.after: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, who is also a deacon of the church in Cenchreae.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is also a servant of the church in Cenchreae,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves welcome, practical assistance, and Phoebe's patronage.
key_decisions.before: Welcome her in the Lord in a way worthy of the holy ones, and help her in whatever matter she may need from you, because she has been a benefactor of many people, including me.
key_decisions.after: Welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she has been a benefactor of many people, including me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that you may receive her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the holy ones, and assist her in whatever matter she may have need of you, for she herself has been a benefactor of many, including myself.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains Junia's feminine name, imprisonment, and apostolic prominence.
key_decisions.before: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before me.
key_decisions.after: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen and fellow prisoners, who are outstanding among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the warning's objects, standard, and response.
key_decisions.before: I urge you, brothers and sisters, to watch out for those who cause divisions and put obstacles in the way contrary to the teaching you learned. Turn away from them.
key_decisions.after: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, to watch out for those who cause divisions and create obstacles contrary to the teaching you learned. Turn away from them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who cause divisions and obstacles contrary to the teaching which you learned, and turn away from them.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the belly idiom's appetite sense and the method of deception.
key_decisions.before: For such people do not serve our Lord Christ but their own appetites, and through smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of unsuspecting people.
key_decisions.after: For such people do not serve our Lord Christ but their own appetites, and through smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of unsuspecting people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For such ones do not serve our Lord Christ, but their own belly, and by smooth speech and flattery they deceive the hearts of the unsuspecting.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the peace/crushing tension and the pinned Christ reading.
key_decisions.before: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.
key_decisions.after: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

key_decisions.before: I, Tertius, the one who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.
key_decisions.after: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I, Tertius, who wrote this letter, greet you in the Lord.
